4593.translation: 把回归结果和实际导出耗时对照检查一下。

2749.text: This cluster contains mostly night scenes.
2749.translation: 这个聚类簇里大多是夜景。

2749.text: A few unrelated clips ended up in the same cluster.
2749.translation: 几个不相关的片段被分到了同一个聚类簇里。

1075.text: Brightness is one feature used to group these photos.
1075.translation: 亮度是这些照片分组时使用的一项特征。

1075.text: Which feature helped the model distinguish the two styles?
1075.translation: 模型依靠哪项特征区分了这两种风格？

2254.text: Give each image a clear label before training.
2254.translation: 训练前，给每张图像加上清楚的标签。

2254.text: The label says indoor, but this photo was taken outside.
2254.translation: 标签写着室内，但这张照片是在室外拍的。

19373.text: The annotation marks the edge of the car.
19373.translation: 这个标注标出了汽车的边缘。

19373.text: Please check the annotation before adding this image to the dataset.
19373.translation: 把这张图加入数据集前，请先检查标注。

19124.text: We need to annotate the faces in these frames.
19124.translation: 我们需要标注这些画面中的人脸。

19124.text: Could you annotate the exact moment when the speaker starts talking?
19124.translation: 你能标出说话人开始讲话的准确时刻吗？

1172.text: This sample has a clear voice and very little background noise.
1172.translation: 这个样本的人声清楚，背景噪声很少。

1172.text: Please remove the sample if we can't confirm its source.
1172.translation: 如果无法确认来源，请移除这个样本。

5617.text: We'll generate one small batch before committing to the style.
5617.translation: 确定画风前，我们会先生成一小批图像。

5617.text: This batch has the right lighting, but the faces need work.
5617.translation: 这批图像的光线对了，不过人脸还需要修改。

10733.text: The training log records the loss after each epoch.
10733.translation: 训练日志记录了每一轮训练结束后的损失值。

10733.text: Save a checkpoint at the end of this epoch.
10733.translation: 在这一轮训练结束时保存一个检查点。

4588.text: Which parameter controls the strength of the style effect?
4588.translation: 哪个参数控制风格效果的强度？

4588.text: Change one parameter at a time so we can compare the results.
4588.translation: 一次只改一个参数，这样我们才能比较结果。

869.text: The model learned a different weight for each input feature.
869.translation: 模型为每项输入特征学习了不同的权重。

869.text: This weight has changed a lot since the last checkpoint.
869.translation: 与上一个检查点相比，这个权重变化很大。

3351.text: We found a bias toward younger faces in the generated portraits.
3351.translation: 我们发现生成的人像偏向年轻面孔。

3351.text: Check whether the bias comes from the training images.
3351.translation: 检查一下这种偏差是否来自训练图像。

737.text: The loss is falling, but the generated images still look blurry.
737.translation: 损失值正在下降，但生成的图像看起来仍然模糊。

737.text: Compare the training loss with the validation loss.
737.translation: 比较一下训练损失和验证损失。

2074.text: Our objective is to keep the speaker's meaning intact.
2074.translation: 我们的目标是完整保留说话人的原意。

2074.text: The training objective needs to match the task we actually care about.
2074.translation: 训练目标需要与我们实际关心的任务一致。

14180.text: The optimization run stopped when the memory ran out.
14180.translation: 内存耗尽时，这次优化运行停止了。

14180.text: Let's compare the images before and after optimization.
14180.translation: 我们对比一下优化前后的图像吧。

11995.text: Use a subtle gradient behind the title.
11995.translation: 在标题后面加一层轻微的渐变。

11995.text: The gradient is too strong near the edge of the image.
11995.translation: 图像边缘附近的渐变太强了。

8448.text: We haven't seen convergence in the training curves yet.
8448.translation: 训练曲线还没有出现收敛的迹象。

8448.text: Check for convergence before starting another long run.
8448.translation: 开始下一次长时间训练前，先检查是否收敛。

6897.text: Did the model converge before the training stopped?
6897.translation: 训练停止前，模型收敛了吗？

6897.text: The model didn't converge with those settings.
6897.translation: 用那组设置，模型没有收敛。

4352.text: The model gives this image a high probability of containing a face.
4352.translation: 模型认为这张图像包含人脸的概率很高。

4352.text: Show the probability next to the predicted label.
4352.translation: 在预测标签旁边显示概率。

3918.text: The report compares the likelihood of the observed data under each model.
3918.translation: 这份报告比较了各个模型下观测数据的似然。

3918.text: We used maximum likelihood to estimate these parameters.
3918.translation: 我们用最大似然来估计这些参数。

16538.text: The report uses entropy to describe uncertainty in the predictions.
16538.translation: 报告用熵来描述预测中的不确定性。

16538.text: Compare the entropy of the two output distributions.
16538.translation: 比较这两个输出分布的熵。

3101.text: Use a random sample of clips for the quality check.
3101.translation: 用随机抽取的一组片段做质量检查。

3101.text: The random background changes make it hard to compare the characters.
3101.translation: 背景的随机变化让角色难以比较。

18020.text: Reducing randomness made the outputs more similar to each other.
18020.translation: 减少随机性后，输出之间变得更相似了。

18020.text: We want some randomness in the textures, but not in the logo.
18020.translation: 我们希望纹理有些随机变化，但标志不能随机变化。

1674.text: Keep the seed unchanged while we test the lighting prompt.
1674.translation: 测试灯光提示词时，保持随机种子不变。

1674.text: Write down the seed and the model version for this image.
1674.translation: 记下这张图使用的随机种子和模型版本。

8521.text: Send the logo as a vector file so we can resize it.
8521.translation: 把标志发成矢量文件，这样我们就能调整尺寸。

8521.text: The search system stores each image as a vector.
8521.translation: 这个检索系统把每张图像存为一个向量。

2495.text: We use a numerical representation to compare the images.
2495.translation: 我们用数值表征来比较图像。

2495.text: Does this representation preserve the details we need for the search?
2495.translation: 这种表征保留了我们检索所需的细节吗？

10066.text: We're exploring the latent space to find a smoother transition.
10066.translation: 我们正在探索潜在空间，寻找更平滑的过渡。

10066.text: The tool lets us edit the image's latent representation.
10066.translation: 这个工具允许我们编辑图像的潜在表征。

566.text: The attention map highlights the words the model focused on.
566.translation: 这张注意力图突出显示了模型重点关注的词。

566.text: Can we inspect the attention patterns for this prompt?
566.translation: 我们能查看这段提示词对应的注意力模式吗？

19889.text: The decoder turns the model's output into a visible image.
19889.translation: 这个解码器把模型的输出变成可见图像。

19889.text: Check the decoder settings if the colors look wrong.
19889.translation: 如果颜色看起来不对，检查一下解码器设置。

3005.text: This model uses a different architecture from the one we tested yesterday.
3005.translation: 这个模型的架构与我们昨天测试的模型不同。

3005.text: The architecture diagram helps explain where the text input enters.
3005.translation: 这张架构图有助于解释文本输入从哪里进入。

10855.text: The activation function is listed in the model configuration.
10855.translation: 模型配置中列出了激活函数。

10855.text: We changed the activation function for this experiment.
10855.translation: 我们在这个实验中更改了激活函数。

1281.text: This function loads the reference image before generation.
1281.translation: 这个函数在生成前加载参考图像。

1281.text: Can you check what this function returns when the file is missing?
1281.translation: 你能检查一下文件缺失时这个函数会返回什么吗？

13463.text: The preprocessing step includes normalization of the image values.
13463.translation: 预处理步骤包括对图像数值进行归一化。

13463.text: Use the same normalization for the training and test images.
13463.translation: 对训练图像和测试图像使用同样的归一化方式。

6720.text: The training configuration includes a dropout rate of 0.1.
6720.translation: 训练配置中的随机失活率为0.1。

6720.text: We tested the model with and without dropout.
6720.translation: 我们测试了使用和不使用随机失活的模型。

9165.text: Keep these clips for validation, not training.
9165.translation: 把这些片段留作验证，不要用于训练。

9165.text: The validation results got worse after the last change.
9165.translation: 上次修改后，验证结果变差了。

2027.text: Include low-light images in the evaluation.
2027.translation: 评估时把弱光图像也纳入进来。

2027.text: Our evaluation checks both image quality and prompt accuracy.
2027.translation: 我们的评估同时检查图像质量和对提示词的准确遵循程度。

6800.text: Run the same benchmark on both models.
6800.translation: 在两个模型上运行同一项基准测试。

6800.text: The benchmark doesn't include the kind of clips our clients send us.
6800.translation: 这项基准测试不包含客户发给我们的那类片段。

8540.text: Which metric matters most for this captioning task?
8540.translation: 对这个图像描述任务来说，哪项评价指标最重要？

8540.text: Don't choose a model based on a single metric.
8540.translation: 别只根据一项指标选择模型。

3469.text: The model's accuracy dropped on blurry images.
3469.translation: 模型在模糊图像上的准确率下降了。

3469.text: We measured accuracy on a separate test set.
3469.translation: 我们在单独的测试集上测量了准确率。

4648.text: The precision score is high, but a few unrelated clips still appear.
4648.translation: 精确率得分很高，但仍有几个不相关的片段出现在结果里。

4648.text: Compare precision at the same number of returned results.
4648.translation: 在返回结果数量相同的情况下比较精确率。

1023.text: We need better recall so the search doesn't miss useful clips.
1023.translation: 我们需要提高召回率，让检索不漏掉有用的片段。

1023.text: The report shows recall for each category of image.
1023.translation: 报告展示了各个图像类别的召回率。

3972.text: The similarity score is high, but the faces are still different.
3972.translation: 相似度得分很高，但两张脸仍然不同。

3972.text: Use similarity search to find footage with the same setting.
3972.translation: 用相似度检索寻找相同场景的素材。

1110.text: The tool compares the distance between image vectors.
1110.translation: 这个工具比较图像向量之间的距离。

1110.text: Which distance measure does this search system use?
1110.translation: 这个检索系统使用哪种距离度量？

3000.text: We found a correlation between clip length and processing time.
3000.translation: 我们发现片段长度与处理时间存在相关性。

3000.text: That correlation doesn't tell us why viewers stopped watching.
3000.translation: 这种相关性无法告诉我们观众为什么停止观看。

4288.text: The report lists the variance in rendering time across these jobs.
4288.translation: 报告列出了这些任务的渲染耗时方差。

4288.text: Compare the variance across several runs, not just one.
4288.translation: 要比较多次运行的方差，别只看一次。

222.text: The mean export time was higher for the longer clips.
222.translation: 较长片段的平均导出时间更高。

222.text: Please include the mean score as well as the individual ratings.
222.translation: 请在列出各个评分的同时，也列出平均分。

5763.text: The median processing time was twelve seconds.
5763.translation: 处理耗时的中位数为十二秒。

5763.text: Use the median to describe a typical run when a few jobs take much longer.
5763.translation: 如果少数任务耗时特别长，用中位数描述典型的运行耗时。

2327.text: The statistics show how often viewers replayed each section.
2327.translation: 这些统计数据显示了观众重播各个段落的频率。

2327.text: Let's check the statistics before changing the opening scene.
2327.translation: 修改开场镜头前，我们先看一下统计数据吧。

3652.text: We need a statistical comparison of the two sets of ratings.
3652.translation: 我们需要对这两组评分进行统计比较。

3652.text: The statistical report includes the sample size for each group.
3652.translation: 这份统计报告包括每个组的样本量。

9230.text: This corpus contains interview transcripts from our own projects.
9230.translation: 这个语料库包含我们自己项目中的采访文字稿。

9230.text: Remove personal details before adding the transcript to the corpus.
9230.translation: 把文字稿加入语料库前，先移除个人信息。

4721.text: The model's vocabulary doesn't include this new product name.
4721.translation: 模型的词表不包含这个新产品名称。

4721.text: Check the vocabulary used by the tokenizer.
4721.translation: 检查一下分词器使用的词表。

2508.text: This segment of the audience prefers shorter tutorials.
2508.translation: 这个细分受众群体更喜欢简短的教程。

2508.text: We made a separate version for each audience segment.
2508.translation: 我们为每个受众细分群体制作了单独的版本。

18876.text: The segmentation tool missed part of the actor's sleeve.
18876.translation: 这个分割工具漏掉了演员的一部分袖子。

18876.text: Check the segmentation mask around the hair.
18876.translation: 检查一下头发周围的分割蒙版。

2700.text: The opening sequence needs one more establishing shot.
2700.translation: 开场镜头序列还需要一个交代场景的镜头。

2700.text: Keep the sequence in this order so the action makes sense.
2700.translation: 让镜头序列保持这个顺序，这样动作才连贯。

10080.text: The tool processes the frames in sequential order.
10080.translation: 这个工具按顺序处理画面。

10080.text: We use sequential frames to check whether the character changes between shots.
10080.translation: 我们用连续的画面检查角色在不同镜头之间是否发生变化。

9586.text: We're testing a recurrent network on the audio sequence.
9586.translation: 我们正在音频序列上测试一个循环网络。

9586.text: The recurrent model needs the inputs in the correct order.
9586.translation: 这个循环模型需要输入按正确顺序排列。

13030.text: The automatic categorization put interviews in the music folder.
13030.translation: 自动分类把采访素材放进了音乐文件夹。

13030.text: We still review the categorization before archiving the clips.
13030.translation: 归档片段前，我们仍会检查分类结果。

2108.text: Speech recognition missed the speaker's name.
2108.translation: 语音识别漏掉了说话人的姓名。

2108.text: The recognition results need a human check before we make the subtitles.
2108.translation: 制作字幕前，识别结果需要人工检查。

728.text: The model couldn't recognize the object in the dark.
728.translation: 模型没能识别出黑暗中的物体。

728.text: Can the tool recognize the same character from a side view?
728.translation: 这个工具能从侧面识别出同一个角色吗？

5278.text: Face detection failed on this wide shot.
5278.translation: 这个远景镜头的人脸检测失败了。

5278.text: We use scene detection to find the cut points in the video.
5278.translation: 我们用场景检测寻找视频中的剪切点。

4659.text: The detector picked up the face on the poster.
4659.translation: 检测器识别到了海报上的人脸。

4659.text: Test the detector on crowded scenes, too.
4659.translation: 也在拥挤场景里测试一下检测器。

11756.text: The retrieval system found three clips with similar lighting.
11756.translation: 检索系统找到了三个光线相似的片段。

11756.text: We need faster retrieval from the footage archive.
11756.translation: 我们需要更快地从素材库中检索视频。

4226.text: Can you retrieve the original file from the archive?
4226.translation: 你能从归档库中找回原始文件吗？

4226.text: The assistant should retrieve the source before writing a factual summary.
4226.translation: 助手应先检索来源，再撰写事实性摘要。

12835.text: We use grounding to keep the product description tied to the approved brief.
12835.translation: 我们用参考信息约束生成，让产品描述以已确认的需求说明为依据。

12835.text: The grounding step should include the latest product sheet.
12835.translation: 参考信息约束这一步应纳入最新的产品资料表。

10497.text: The made-up quote is a hallucination, so we need to remove it.
10497.translation: 这条编造的引语是模型幻觉，需要删除。

10497.text: Check for hallucination before using the generated summary in the video.
10497.translation: 把生成的摘要用在视频里之前，先检查是否存在模型幻觉。

7568.text: The factual details in the script need checking.
7568.translation: 脚本中的事实细节需要核对。

7568.text: Keep factual claims separate from the character's opinions.
7568.translation: 把事实性陈述和角色的观点分开。

17534.text: Check the summary's faithfulness to the original interview.
17534.translation: 检查摘要是否忠实于原始采访。

17534.text: We assess faithfulness by comparing the answer with the supplied sources.
17534.translation: 我们通过将回答与提供的来源对照，来评估它的忠实度。

12642.text: The team uses adversarial tests to find weak points in the assistant.
12642.translation: 团队用对抗性测试寻找助手的薄弱环节。

12642.text: This adversarial prompt tried to make the model ignore the brief.
12642.translation: 这条对抗性提示词试图让模型忽视需求说明。

6658.text: Check the alignment of the model's answers with our content guidelines.
6658.translation: 检查模型的回答是否与我们的内容规范一致。

6658.text: The team reviews alignment before letting the assistant publish drafts.
6658.translation: 让助手发布草稿前，团队会检查它是否符合既定要求。

664.text: The export loses the fine texture on the fabric.
664.translation: 导出后，布料上的细致纹理丢失了。

664.text: Keep the fine lines around the eyes in this portrait.
664.translation: 这张肖像要保留眼睛周围细致的线条。

3122.text: Can you tune the effect so the glow is less intense?
3122.translation: 能调整一下效果，让发光没那么强吗？

3122.text: We need to tune the model for short customer replies.
3122.translation: 我们需要调整模型，让它适合生成简短的客户回复。

4429.text: This adaptation turns the interview into a short animation.
4429.translation: 这次改编把采访做成了一部短动画。

4429.text: Model adaptation will use examples from our own support team.
4429.translation: 模型适配会使用我们客服团队自己的例子。

11443.text: Load the style adapter before generating the next portrait.
11443.translation: 生成下一张肖像前，先加载风格适配器。

11443.text: Can this adapter work with the new base model?
11443.translation: 这个适配器能配合新的基础模型使用吗？

1997.text: We are testing transfer learning with a small set of product photos.
1997.translation: 我们正在用一小组产品照片测试迁移学习。

1997.text: The team uses transfer learning rather than training the image model from scratch.
1997.translation: 团队采用迁移学习，而不是从头训练图像模型。

8221.text: Which checkpoint did you use for the final image?
8221.translation: 最终这张图用的是哪个模型检查点？

8221.text: Save a checkpoint before the next training run.
8221.translation: 开始下一轮训练前，先保存一个模型检查点。

7061.text: The text becomes hard to read after image compression.
7061.translation: 图像压缩后，文字变得难以辨认。

7061.text: Compare both clips before choosing a compression setting.
7061.translation: 选择压缩设置前，先对比这两段视频。

18123.text: Could distillation make this model small enough to run locally?
18123.translation: 蒸馏能否让这个模型缩小到可以在本地运行？

18123.text: After distillation, test whether the smaller model still follows the brief.
18123.translation: 蒸馏后，测试一下小模型是否仍能遵循需求说明。

384.text: The teacher model generates sample answers for training.
384.translation: 教师模型会生成用于训练的示例回答。

384.text: We check the teacher model's answers before using them in the dataset.
384.translation: 将教师模型的回答放入数据集前，我们会先检查。

224.text: The student model is smaller, so we test it on the laptop.
224.translation: 学生模型更小，所以我们用笔记本测试它。

224.text: Does the student model preserve the tone of the teacher's replies?
224.translation: 学生模型能保留教师模型回复的语气吗？

2914.text: The reward signal favors answers that match the supplied sources.
2914.translation: 奖励信号偏向与提供的来源一致的回答。

2914.text: Check whether the reward is encouraging the model to repeat phrases.
2914.translation: 检查一下奖励信号是否在鼓励模型重复措辞。

2303.text: A repetition penalty reduced the repeated lines in this output.
2303.translation: 重复惩罚项减少了这次输出中的重复句子。

2303.text: The penalty should not remove names that the script needs to repeat.
2303.translation: 惩罚项不应让剧本中必须重复的人名消失。

1434.text: Which temperature did you use for this run?
1434.translation: 这一轮生成用了什么采样温度？

1434.text: This model does not expose a temperature setting.
1434.translation: 这个模型没有提供采样温度设置。

4028.text: Raise the threshold before automatically approving images.
4028.translation: 自动通过图片前，先提高判定阈值。

4028.text: How did you choose the threshold for flagging duplicate clips?
4028.translation: 你是怎样选择标记重复视频片段的阈值的？

1637.text: A high confidence score does not prove the answer is correct.
1637.translation: 置信度分数高，并不能证明回答正确。

1637.text: Show the confidence score next to each predicted label.
1637.translation: 在每个预测标签旁边显示置信度分数。

3185.text: The model should express uncertainty when the source is unclear.
3185.translation: 来源不清楚时，模型应该表达不确定性。

3185.text: We review predictions with high uncertainty before publishing them.
3185.translation: 发布前，我们会审核不确定性较高的预测结果。

3475.text: The output has the right colors but the wrong camera angle.
3475.translation: 输出结果的颜色对了，但镜头角度不对。

3475.text: Can you save the output without adding a border?
3475.translation: 能保存输出结果而不加边框吗？

3504.text: The input image is too small for this close-up.
3504.translation: 输入图像太小，不适合做这个特写。

3504.text: Keep a copy of the input so we can compare it with the result.
3504.translation: 保留一份输入素材，方便我们与结果对比。

1384.text: Add an instruction to keep the character's jacket blue.
1384.translation: 加一条指令，让角色的外套保持蓝色。

1384.text: The model ignored the instruction about leaving space for the title.
1384.translation: 模型没有遵循为标题留出空间的指令。

2324.text: The assistant can draft captions, but I review them before posting.
2324.translation: 助手可以起草配文，但发布前我会检查。

2324.text: Ask the assistant to summarize the changes between these two drafts.
2324.translation: 请助手总结这两版草稿之间的变化。

1588.text: Let the user edit the prompt before starting generation.
1588.translation: 开始生成前，让用户可以修改提示词。

1588.text: The user should see the estimated cost before submitting the job.
1588.translation: 提交任务前，用户应该看到预计费用。

249.text: The system message defines how the assistant should handle missing information.
249.translation: 系统消息规定助手应如何处理缺失的信息。

249.text: Our system keeps the source files separate from the generated results.
249.translation: 我们的系统把源文件与生成结果分开保存。

753.text: This message is too long for the caption field.
753.translation: 这条消息太长，放不进配文输入框。

753.text: Send a message when the video is ready for review.
753.translation: 视频可以审看时，发一条消息通知我。

1056.text: Keep the character notes in the same conversation.
1056.translation: 把角色设定记录放在同一个对话里。

1056.text: Can I export this conversation with the image references?
1056.translation: 能把这段对话连同参考图一起导出吗？

11339.text: Give the narrator a relaxed, conversational tone.
11339.translation: 让旁白带一点轻松的交谈语气。

11339.text: This assistant needs conversational replies rather than formal reports.
11339.translation: 这个助手需要交谈式回复，而不是正式报告。

4309.text: Open a new chat for the second campaign.
4309.translation: 为第二个宣传项目新建一个对话。

4309.text: The reference image is attached in the chat above.
4309.translation: 参考图附在上面的对话里。

10700.text: Audio is the only input modality used in this test.
10700.translation: 这次测试只使用音频这一种输入模态。

10700.text: Does the model support more than one modality at the same time?
10700.translation: 这个模型支持同时处理多种模态吗？

373.text: Ask the model to reason about the order of the scenes before drafting them.
373.translation: 起草场景前，先让模型推理一下场景顺序。

373.text: What is the reason for changing the character's costume here?
373.translation: 这里为什么要改变角色的服装？

681.text: The response includes a title that was not in the brief.
681.translation: 回复中包含了需求说明里没有的标题。

681.text: Shorten the response without removing the source links.
681.translation: 缩短回复，但不要删掉来源链接。

4281.text: The text completion repeats the opening sentence.
4281.translation: 文本补全结果重复了开头的句子。

4281.text: Save the completion with the prompt that produced it.
4281.translation: 把补全文本和生成它的提示词一起保存。

1925.text: The app shows the text stream as the answer arrives.
1925.translation: 回答逐步返回时，应用会显示文本流。

1925.text: The audio stream stops when I switch to another tab.
1925.translation: 切换到另一个标签页时，音频流就停止了。

15744.text: The extra review step increases latency before the first reply.
15744.translation: 额外的审核步骤增加了首次回复前的延迟。

15744.text: Measure latency on the same network when comparing these models.
15744.translation: 对比这些模型时，在同一网络上测量延迟。

17801.text: We measure throughput by counting completed jobs per minute.
17801.translation: 我们通过统计每分钟完成的任务数来测量吞吐量。

17801.text: Higher throughput matters when we generate hundreds of product images.
17801.translation: 要生成数百张产品图时，更高的吞吐量就很重要。

6603.text: We do not have enough compute for another full training run today.
6603.translation: 今天我们没有足够的计算资源再跑一轮完整训练。

6603.text: Reserve some compute for testing the final model.
6603.translation: 留一些计算资源用于测试最终模型。

11083.text: This effect has a high computational cost at full resolution.
11083.translation: 这个效果在全分辨率下需要较高的计算开销。

11083.text: What are the computational requirements for running this model offline?
11083.translation: 离线运行这个模型需要具备什么计算条件？

3931.text: The video encoder is using most of the processor's capacity.
3931.translation: 视频编码器占用了处理器的大部分计算能力。

3931.text: Which processor will run the local model during the demo?
3931.translation: 演示时，本地模型会在哪个处理器上运行？

816.text: Close the unused model to free up memory.
816.translation: 关闭不用的模型，释放内存。

816.text: This image size requires more memory than the laptop has available.
816.translation: 这个图像尺寸需要的内存超过了笔记本当前可用的内存。

2523.text: We need more storage for the original video files.
2523.translation: 我们需要更多存储空间来保存原始视频文件。

2523.text: Check the storage location before exporting all the clips.
2523.translation: 导出所有片段前，检查一下存储位置。

5318.text: The server is busy, so the new job is waiting.
5318.translation: 服务器正忙，新任务还在等待。

5318.text: Can the server return a clear error when generation fails?
5318.translation: 生成失败时，服务器能返回明确的错误信息吗？

1670.text: The cloud service finished the render overnight.
1670.translation: 云服务在夜里完成了渲染。

1670.text: Check the upload settings before sending private footage to the cloud.
1670.translation: 把私密视频发送到云端前，先检查上传设置。

430.text: I use a local model when working offline.
430.translation: 离线工作时，我会使用本地模型。

430.text: Keep a local copy of the finished video as well.
430.translation: 也保留一份最终视频的本地副本。

2383.text: The remote machine is still rendering the last scene.
2383.translation: 远程机器还在渲染最后一个场景。

2383.text: Can you check the remote job without downloading the whole video?
2383.translation: 能不下载整段视频就查看远程任务吗？

5451.text: The deployment includes the model and the caption editor.
5451.translation: 这次部署包含模型和配文编辑器。

5451.text: Test file uploads after deployment, not just the home page.
5451.translation: 部署后要测试文件上传，而不只是检查首页。

3832.text: Do not deploy this version until the preview works on a phone.
3832.translation: 等预览在手机上正常运行后，再部署这个版本。

3832.text: We can deploy the smaller model on the studio computer.
3832.translation: 我们可以在工作室电脑上部署这个较小的模型。

16316.translation: 哪个接口端点接收图片上传？

16316.text: The endpoint returns a job ID rather than the finished video.
16316.translation: 这个接口端点返回任务编号，而不是完成的视频。

5244.text: The interface should make the download button easy to find.
5244.translation: 界面应该让下载按钮容易找到。

5244.text: This interface accepts both a text prompt and a reference image.
5244.translation: 这个接口同时接收文本提示词和参考图。

1347.text: The application saves a draft when I close the editor.
1347.translation: 关闭编辑器时，应用会保存一份草稿。

1347.text: Can the application show two image versions side by side?
1347.translation: 这个应用能并排显示两个图片版本吗？

3061.text: The integration sends approved captions to our publishing tool.
3061.translation: 这项集成会把已审核的配文发送到我们的发布工具。

3061.text: Test the integration with one image before importing the full collection.
3061.translation: 导入整套素材前，先用一张图片测试这项集成。

4417.text: Our pipeline adds subtitles after the voice track is approved.
4417.translation: 我们的处理流水线会在配音通过审核后添加字幕。

4417.text: Where does the pipeline store failed generation attempts?
4417.translation: 这条处理流水线把生成失败的记录存在哪里？

6692.text: This node resizes the image before it reaches the video model.
6692.translation: 这个节点会在图像送入视频模型前调整尺寸。

6692.text: Connect the audio node to the preview player.
6692.translation: 把音频节点连接到预览播放器。

1266.text: The connection between these two nodes is missing.
1266.translation: 这两个节点之间缺少连接。

1266.text: A slow connection makes it hard to upload the reference video.
1266.translation: 网络连接很慢，参考视频不容易上传。

10452.text: The connector needs permission to read our asset folder.
10452.translation: 这个连接器需要读取素材文件夹的权限。

10452.text: Does the connector keep the original file names?
10452.translation: 这个连接器会保留原始文件名吗？

2740.text: This extension adds a caption panel to the editor.
2740.translation: 这个扩展组件为编辑器增加了配文面板。

2740.text: Disable the extension and check whether playback improves.
2740.translation: 关闭这个扩展组件，看看播放是否变流畅。

1154.text: Which tool did you use to remove the background?
1154.translation: 你用哪个工具去掉了背景？

1154.text: The tool should ask before overwriting an existing image.
1154.translation: 覆盖已有图片前，工具应该先询问。

2219.text: This utility checks whether any frames are missing.
2219.translation: 这个工具程序会检查是否缺少帧。

2219.text: Run the utility on a copy of the folder first.
2219.translation: 先在文件夹的副本上运行这个工具程序。

2548.text: The framework handles uploads and generation status updates.
2548.translation: 这个框架负责处理上传和生成状态更新。

2548.text: Does this framework support the model provider we use?
2548.translation: 这个框架支持我们使用的模型服务商吗？

1847.text: The library contains sound effects that our team can use.
1847.translation: 素材库里收录了团队可以使用的音效。

1847.text: Update the image-processing library before testing this script.
1847.translation: 测试这个脚本前，先更新图像处理库。

5340.text: The subtitle module is separate from the voice generator.
5340.translation: 字幕模块与语音生成器是分开的。

5340.text: Can we disable this module without stopping the editor?
5340.translation: 能在不关闭编辑器的情况下停用这个模块吗？

1481.text: Install the package in the test environment first.
1481.translation: 先在测试环境中安装这个软件包。

1481.text: This package adds support for another video format.
1481.translation: 这个软件包增加了对另一种视频格式的支持。

6613.text: The new dependency makes the app much larger.
6613.translation: 新增的依赖项让应用大了很多。

6613.text: Check whether this dependency is still needed for audio export.
6613.translation: 检查一下音频导出是否还需要这个依赖项。

1025.text: Which version of the model created this image?
1025.translation: 这张图是哪个版本的模型生成的？

1025.text: Keep the previous version until we approve the new result.
1025.translation: 等我们确认新结果后，再移除旧版本。

4093.text: The update fixes the broken audio preview.
4093.translation: 这次更新修好了无法使用的音频预览。

4093.text: Can you update the prompt without replacing the reference image?
4093.translation: 能只更新提示词，不替换参考图吗？

5026.text: We should test the upgrade with an old project.
5026.translation: 我们应该用一个旧项目测试这次升级。

5026.text: Does the upgrade change how the editor handles fonts?
5026.translation: 这次升级会改变编辑器处理字体的方式吗？

1015.text: The release includes a new image comparison view.
1015.translation: 这个发布版本增加了新的图片对比界面。

1015.text: Write the release notes in language that creators understand.
1015.translation: 用创作者能看懂的语言写版本说明。

5942.text: This font is compatible with the export tool.
5942.translation: 这个字体与导出工具兼容。

5942.text: Check whether the adapter is compatible with this model version.
5942.translation: 检查一下适配器是否与这个模型版本兼容。

10861.text: We are testing compatibility with the older project files.
10861.translation: 我们正在测试对旧项目文件的兼容性。

10861.text: The plugin page should list compatibility requirements clearly.
10861.translation: 插件页面应该清楚列出兼容性要求。

5214.text: Save the configuration that produced the approved image.
5214.translation: 保存生成已确认图片时所用的配置。

5214.text: The configuration includes the model name and output size.
5214.translation: 这份配置包含模型名称和输出尺寸。

11084.text: Can you configure the editor to save drafts automatically?
11084.translation: 能把编辑器配置成自动保存草稿吗？

11084.text: We need to configure the upload limit before the public demo.
11084.translation: 公开演示前，我们需要配置上传限制。

19766.text: This preset gives the narration a warmer tone.
19766.translation: 这个预设让旁白的音色更温暖。

19766.text: Save the subtitle style as a preset for future videos.
19766.translation: 把字幕样式保存成预设，方便以后的视频使用。

6273.text: The default image size is too small for the poster.
6273.translation: 默认图像尺寸太小，不适合做海报。

6273.text: Can users change the default voice before generating speech?
6273.translation: 用户能在生成语音前修改默认声音吗？

2569.text: We need a custom layout for the vertical trailer.
2569.translation: 我们需要为竖屏预告片设计一个自定义布局。

2569.text: This model can load a custom style adapter.
2569.translation: 这个模型可以加载自定义风格适配器。

9574.text: Let creators customize the subtitle colors.
9574.translation: 让创作者可以自定义字幕颜色。

9574.text: Can I customize this workflow without editing code?
9574.translation: 我能不改代码就定制这个工作流吗？

1000.text: Choose the option that keeps the original aspect ratio.
1000.translation: 选择保留原始宽高比的选项。

1000.text: The export menu needs an option for saving audio only.
1000.translation: 导出菜单需要一个只保存音频的选项。

437.text: Use this control to adjust the strength of the effect.
437.translation: 用这个控件调整效果强度。

437.text: I need more control over the camera movement.
437.translation: 我需要更细致地控制镜头运动。

12760.text: Move the slider a little to reduce the blur.
12760.translation: 稍微移动滑块，减轻模糊效果。

12760.text: The slider should show its current value next to it.
12760.translation: 滑块旁边应该显示当前数值。

2277.text: The play button is hard to tap on a phone.
2277.translation: 播放按钮在手机上不容易点到。

2277.text: Add a button that restores the original image.
2277.translation: 加一个恢复原图的按钮。

1422.text: Open the audio panel to adjust the voice level.
1422.translation: 打开音频面板，调整人声的音量。

1422.text: The preview panel should stay visible while I edit the prompt.
1422.translation: 我编辑提示词时，预览面板应该保持可见。

9745.text: The dashboard shows how many jobs are still waiting.
9745.translation: 控制面板会显示还有多少任务在等待。

9745.text: Can the dashboard separate draft images from approved ones?
9745.translation: 控制面板能把草稿图片与已确认的图片分开吗？

19981.text: Keep this client's assets in a separate workspace.
19981.translation: 把这位客户的素材放在独立的工作区。

19981.text: Invite the editor to the workspace before sending the review link.
19981.translation: 发送审看链接前，先邀请剪辑师加入工作区。

522.text: The project includes the script, audio, and reference images.
522.translation: 这个项目包含剧本、音频和参考图。

522.text: Make a copy of the project before changing the frame rate.
522.translation: 修改帧率前，先复制一份项目。

1813.text: This asset is missing from the opening scene.
1813.translation: 开场场景缺少这个素材。

1813.text: Record where each asset came from when you import it.
1813.translation: 导入时，记录每个素材的来源。

719.text: The team shares a resource folder for approved fonts.
719.translation: 团队共用一个资源文件夹，存放已确认可用的字体。

719.text: This tutorial is a useful resource for learning the editor.
719.translation: 这份教程是学习编辑器的实用资源。

6018.text: Put the voice recordings in their own folder.
6018.translation: 把录音放在单独的文件夹里。

6018.text: This folder contains the images we have not reviewed yet.
6018.translation: 这个文件夹里是我们尚未审核的图片。

6929.text: The output directory is on the external drive.
6929.translation: 输出目录位于外接硬盘上。

6929.text: Check the directory before running the batch export.
6929.translation: 批量导出前，检查一下目录。

85.text: The file opens, but its audio track is silent.
85.translation: 文件能打开，但音轨没有声音。

85.text: Keep the source file alongside the exported video.
85.translation: 把源文件和导出的视频放在一起保存。

1194.text: The file path contains a space, so the script needs to handle it.
1194.translation: 文件路径里有空格，脚本需要正确处理。

1194.text: Show the full path when an image cannot be found.
1194.translation: 找不到图片时，显示完整路径。

1517.text: Send me the preview link when the upload finishes.
1517.translation: 上传完成后，把预览链接发给我。

1517.text: This link opens the draft rather than the final video.
1517.translation: 这个链接打开的是草稿，而不是最终视频。

3781.text: Add a tag for the character's name so we can find the images later.
3781.translation: 添加一个角色姓名标签，方便以后找图。

3781.text: The tag should stay with the asset when we move it to another folder.
3781.translation: 把素材移到另一个文件夹时，标签应该保留。

1296.text: Put these clips in the travel category.
1296.translation: 把这些片段归入旅行类别。

1296.text: Which category should we use for behind-the-scenes footage?
1296.translation: 幕后花絮应该归入哪个类别？

3782.text: The asset catalog lists the source of each sound effect.
3782.translation: 素材目录列出了每个音效的来源。

3782.text: Search the catalog before generating another background.
3782.translation: 生成另一个背景前，先搜索素材目录。

948.text: This collection contains all the approved character portraits.
948.translation: 这个素材集合包含所有已确认的角色肖像。

948.text: Can I share the collection without sharing the whole workspace?
948.translation: 我能只分享这个素材集合，而不分享整个工作区吗？

5515.text: Move the finished project into the archive.
5515.translation: 把已完成的项目移入归档区。

5515.text: The archive includes the original prompts, not just the final images.
5515.translation: 归档里包含原始提示词，而不只是最终图片。

4658.text: Make a backup before updating the editor.
4658.translation: 更新编辑器前，先做一份备份。

4658.text: Have we tested whether this backup can actually be restored?
4658.translation: 我们测试过这份备份是否真的能恢复吗？

2193.text: Can you restore the version from yesterday?
We need to restore the missing font before exporting the poster.
2193.translation: 导出海报前，我们需要恢复缺失的字体。

3446.text: Try to import one clip before adding the rest.
3446.translation: 添加其余片段前，先试着导入一个片段。

3446.text: Can the editor import captions with their timing intact?
3446.translation: 编辑器能保留字幕时间信息进行导入吗？

5416.text: Let me download the original image, not just the preview.
5416.translation: 让我下载原图，而不只是预览图。

5416.text: The download should include the subtitle file as well.
5416.translation: 下载内容也应该包含字幕文件。

86.text: Please save the prompt before starting another generation.
86.translation: 开始另一次生成前，请先保存提示词。

86.text: Can I save this voice setting for the next episode?
86.translation: 我能保存这个声音设置，用于下一集吗？

5608.text: Use undo to bring back the deleted title.
5608.translation: 使用撤销功能恢复删掉的标题。

5608.text: Can I undo this crop after closing the image editor?
5608.translation: 关闭图像编辑器后，我还能撤销这次裁剪吗？

10735.text: The reset button clears the style settings.
10735.translation: 重置按钮会清除风格设置。

10735.text: Do not reset the scene until we have saved a copy.
10735.translation: 保存副本前，不要重置这个场景。

7801.text: Can you duplicate this scene and change only the background?
7801.translation: 能复制这个场景，只修改背景吗？

7801.text: I want to duplicate the project before testing a different voice.
7801.translation: 我想先复制项目，再试另一个声音。

1679.text: Make a copy of the prompt that produced this result.
1679.translation: 复制一份生成这个结果所用的提示词。

1679.text: Can I copy the subtitle style to the next clip?
1679.translation: 我能把字幕样式复制到下一个片段吗？

6447.text: Please paste the corrected caption into the text field.
6447.translation: 请把修改后的配文粘贴到文本框里。

6447.text: When I paste the script, the paragraph breaks disappear.
6447.translation: 我粘贴剧本时，分段消失了。

6781.text: Do not delete the original recording after generating the voice track.
6781.translation: 生成配音后，不要删掉原始录音。

6781.text: Can users delete an uploaded image from their account?
6781.translation: 用户能从账户中删除已上传的图片吗？

805.text: Please remove the watermark from our own draft overlay.
805.translation: 请移除我们自己加在草稿上的水印图层。

805.text: We need to remove the empty space at the start of the clip.
805.translation: 我们需要移除片段开头的空白部分。

1070.text: Can you replace the background without changing the character?
1070.translation: 能替换背景而不改变角色吗？

1070.text: Please replace this temporary music with the approved track.
1070.translation: 请把这段临时音乐替换成已确认可用的曲目。

7805.text: Rename the exports so the scene numbers come first.
7805.translation: 重命名导出文件，让场景编号排在最前面。

7805.text: Can I rename an asset without breaking its links in the timeline?
7805.translation: 我重命名素材后，它在时间线中的链接还能保持正常吗？

1520.text: Select the face before applying the correction.
1520.translation: 应用修正前，先选中脸部。

1520.text: Can I select several clips and lower their volume together?
1520.translation: 我能选择多个片段，同时降低它们的音量吗？

1851.text: The selection includes part of the background.
1851.translation: 这个选区包含了一部分背景。

1851.text: Expand the selection slightly so the edge blends better.
1851.translation: 稍微扩大选区，让边缘融合得更自然。

6374.text: The preview looks sharp, but the export looks blurry.
6374.translation: 预览很清晰，但导出结果看起来模糊。

6374.text: Show a preview before charging for the full render.
6374.translation: 对完整渲染收费前，先展示预览。

15361.text: Playback stops halfway through the second scene.
15361.translation: 播放到第二个场景的一半时就停了。

15361.text: Check playback with headphones before approving the voice mix.
15361.translation: 确认人声混音前，戴耳机播放检查一下。

503.text: The player should let me jump back five seconds.
503.translation: 播放器应该让我能往回跳五秒。

503.text: This player shows subtitles, but it cannot switch audio tracks.
503.translation: 这个播放器能显示字幕，但不能切换音轨。

2382.text: Add a short pause before the final line.
2382.translation: 最后一句台词前加一个短暂停顿。

2382.text: Can I pause the preview without stopping the render?
2382.translation: 我能暂停预览，而不停止渲染吗？

3234.text: Click play to resume the video from this frame.
3234.translation: 点击播放，从这一帧继续播放视频。

3234.text: The player should resume where I left off.
3234.translation: 播放器应该从我上次停下的位置继续播放。

3613.text: Put the short animation on a loop while we discuss it.
3613.translation: 我们讨论时，让这段短动画循环播放。

3613.text: The loop has a visible jump between the last and first frames.
3613.translation: 这个循环的末帧和首帧之间有明显跳变。

1417.text: Could you repeat that line with a softer voice?
1417.translation: 能用更柔和的声音再说一遍那句台词吗？

1417.text: The clip is set to repeat until the reviewer stops it.
1417.translation: 这个片段设成了重复播放，直到审看者停止它。

1239.text: Lower the playback speed so we can inspect the hand movement.
1239.translation: 降低播放速度，方便我们检查手部动作。

1239.text: At normal speed, the transition looks much smoother.
1239.translation: 以正常速度播放时，这个转场看起来顺畅得多。

4613.text: The total duration is longer than the brief allows.
4613.translation: 总时长超过了需求说明规定的长度。

4613.text: Show the duration of each clip next to its thumbnail.
4613.translation: 在每个片段的缩略图旁显示时长。

1624.text: Reduce the length of the opening shot by two seconds.
What is the maximum clip length for this export format?
1624.translation: 这种导出格式允许的最大片段长度是多少？

10910.text: The lip movements are out of sync with the voice.
10910.translation: 嘴唇动作与人声不同步。

10910.text: Can you sync the subtitle timing with the revised recording?
10910.translation: 能把字幕时间调整到与修改后的录音同步吗？

19515.text: Audio synchronization is off after the frame-rate change.
19515.translation: 修改帧率后，音频同步出现了偏差。

19515.text: Check synchronization at both the start and end of the video.
19515.translation: 在视频开头和结尾都检查一下同步情况。

12924.text: We need to synchronize the captions with the final voice track.
12924.translation: 我们需要让字幕与最终配音同步。

12924.text: Can this editor synchronize footage from both cameras?
12924.translation: 这个编辑器能同步两台摄像机的素材吗？

17678.text: This synchronous call waits for the result before returning.
17678.translation: 这个同步调用会等待结果后再返回。

17678.text: A long synchronous operation freezes the preview in our current app.
17678.translation: 在我们当前的应用中，耗时较长的同步操作会让预览卡住。

4949.text: The two clips are rendering in parallel.
4949.translation: 这两个片段正在并行渲染。

4949.text: Can the workflow run image generation and audio cleanup in parallel?
4949.translation: 这个工作流能并行执行图像生成和音频清理吗？

12946.text: The video is still in the generation queue.
12946.translation: 这段视频还在生成队列里。

12946.text: Show the queue position so creators know their job is waiting.
12946.translation: 显示排队位置，让创作者知道任务正在等待。

284.text: This job failed before it generated any frames.
284.translation: 这个任务还没生成任何帧就失败了。

284.text: Keep the job ID so we can find the result later.
284.translation: 保留任务编号，方便以后找到结果。

950.text: The next task is to check the character's hands.
950.translation: 下一个任务是检查角色的手部。

950.text: Assign the subtitle task to someone who can review both languages.
950.translation: 把字幕任务交给能审校两种语言的人。

1094.text: The status still says rendering, but the video is ready.
1094.translation: 视频已经完成，但状态仍显示正在渲染。

1094.text: Can the status page explain why this job stopped?
1094.translation: 状态页面能说明这个任务为什么停止吗？

1338.text: The progress bar has not moved for several minutes.
1338.translation: 进度条已经好几分钟没动了。

1338.text: Show progress separately for upload and rendering.
1338.translation: 把上传进度和渲染进度分开显示。

5766.text: The pending jobs will start when a worker becomes available.
5766.translation: 有空闲工作进程时，待处理任务就会开始。

5766.text: This image is still pending review, so do not publish it yet.
5766.translation: 这张图仍在等待审核，先不要发布。

1087.text: Can you complete the sound check before the review meeting?
1087.translation: 能在审看会议前完成声音检查吗？

1087.text: The export is complete, but we still need to watch the whole video.
1087.translation: 导出已经完成，但我们还需要完整看一遍视频。

1216.text: The render failure happened during the final scene.
1216.translation: 渲染失败发生在最后一个场景。

1216.text: Record the failure message before trying the job again.
1216.translation: 重试任务前，先记录失败信息。

87.text: The error message does not say which file is missing.
87.translation: 错误信息没有说明缺少哪个文件。

87.text: This spelling error appears in every generated caption.
87.translation: 这个拼写错误出现在每条生成的配文里。

3343.text: Can I cancel the queued job before it starts?
3343.translation: 我能在排队任务开始前取消它吗？

3343.text: Please cancel this export; it uses the old voice track.
3343.translation: 请取消这次导出，它用的是旧配音。

5132.text: The account has no image-generation quota left today.
5132.translation: 这个账户今天的图像生成额度用完了。

5132.text: Check the quota before submitting all the scenes at once.
5132.translation: 一次提交所有场景前，先检查额度。

1205.text: The upload limit is too low for this reference video.
1205.translation: 上传限制太低，这段参考视频传不上去。

1205.text: Can we set a spending limit for each project?
1205.translation: 我们能为每个项目设置支出上限吗？

5390.text: The usage page separates image jobs from video jobs.
5390.translation: 用量页面把图像任务与视频任务分开统计。

5390.text: Check yesterday's usage before estimating this week's cost.
5390.translation: 估算本周费用前，先看看昨天的用量。

1019.text: The test image used one credit from the account.
1019.translation: 这张测试图消耗了账户里的一个生成点数。

1019.text: Give the photographer credit in the end titles.
1019.translation: 在片尾字幕中为摄影师署名。

7003.text: Does this subscription include high-resolution downloads?
7003.translation: 这个订阅包含高分辨率下载吗？

7003.text: Check the renewal date before changing the subscription.
7003.translation: 修改订阅前，先检查续订日期。

7436.text: The billing page should show the cost of each generation.
7436.translation: 计费页面应该显示每次生成的费用。

7436.text: Who handles billing for the team's shared account?
7436.translation: 谁负责团队共用账户的计费事务？

534.text: What is the cost of generating a ten-second clip?
534.translation: 生成一段十秒的视频要多少钱？

534.text: Include failed attempts when calculating the total production cost.
534.translation: 计算总制作成本时，也要计入失败尝试的费用。

956.text: We have enough budget for one more version of the scene.
956.translation: 我们的预算还够再做一个版本的场景。

956.text: Leave some budget for captions and sound editing.
956.translation: 留一些预算给字幕和声音剪辑。

1574.text: Can you estimate the cost before we start the batch?
1574.translation: 开始批量生成前，能估算一下费用吗？

1574.text: This estimate does not include another round of revisions.
1574.translation: 这份估算没有包括再修改一轮的费用。

2779.text: Do we have permission to use this recording in the trailer?
2779.translation: 我们获得了在预告片中使用这段录音的许可吗？

2779.text: The app asks for permission before accessing my photo folder.
2779.translation: 应用访问我的照片文件夹前，会先请求权限。

8229.text: Keep the written authorization with the project files.
8229.translation: 把书面授权和项目文件放在一起保存。

8229.text: We need authorization from the speaker before cloning this voice.
8229.translation: 克隆这个声音前，我们需要取得说话者的授权。

3069.text: The contract should explain ownership of the commissioned artwork.
3069.translation: 合同应该说明委托创作作品的所有权。

3069.text: Ask about ownership before handing over the source files.
3069.translation: 交付源文件前，先问清楚所有权问题。

928.text: Who is the owner of the original recording?
928.translation: 原始录音的权利人是谁？

928.text: Contact the rights owner before reusing this song.
928.translation: 再次使用这首歌前，先联系权利人。

1832.text: The notes explain how AI was used during the creation of the animation.
1832.translation: 这些记录说明了动画创作过程中如何使用AI。

1832.text: The tutorial walks through the creation of a short animated scene.
1832.translation: 这份教程逐步介绍一个短动画场景的创作过程。

1030.text: The client wants an original character rather than a familiar movie hero.
1030.translation: 客户想要一个原创角色，而不是大家熟悉的电影英雄。

1030.text: Keep the original sketch so the illustrator can compare the changes.
1030.translation: 保留原始草图，方便插画师对比修改内容。

10321.text: The review checks originality as well as visual quality.
10321.translation: 这次审看既检查原创性，也检查视觉质量。

10321.text: A new file name tells us nothing about the image's originality.
10321.translation: 一个新的文件名并不能说明图片有原创性。

9067.text: We need to ask whether the license allows a derivative work.
9067.translation: 我们需要询问该许可是否允许创作衍生作品。

9067.text: This derivative illustration uses elements from the earlier poster.
9067.translation: 这幅衍生插画使用了之前海报中的元素。

5856.text: Does the music agreement include a royalty payment?
5856.translation: 音乐协议包含版税支付吗？

5856.text: The royalty report lists the videos that used the track.
5856.translation: 版税报告列出了使用这首曲目的视频。

933.text: Check the license before using the image in a commercial campaign.
933.translation: 把图片用于商业宣传前，先检查许可。

933.text: The brief says this video is for commercial use.
933.translation: 需求说明写明，这段视频将用于商业用途。

13302.text: The team is discussing commercialization of its animation tool.
13302.translation: 团队正在讨论动画工具的商业化。

13302.text: We need a support plan before commercialization begins.
13302.translation: 开始商业化前，我们需要制定支持服务方案。

18550.text: This project is a noncommercial student exhibition.
18550.translation: 这个项目是一次非商业的学生作品展。

18550.text: The client asked whether the recording permits noncommercial use.
18550.translation: 客户询问这段录音是否允许非商业使用。

13074.text: The review flagged a possible copyright infringement for further checking.
13074.translation: 审核标记了一项可能的版权侵权问题，留待进一步核查。

13074.text: Send the infringement complaint to the person handling rights requests.
13074.translation: 把侵权投诉转给负责权利相关请求的人。

15519.text: The editor raised a plagiarism concern about the opening paragraph.
15519.translation: 编辑对开头一段提出了抄袭疑虑。

15519.text: We review plagiarism reports against the original sources.
15519.translation: 我们会把抄袭报告与原始来源对照检查。

5742.text: The image contains a trademark that was not in our prompt.
5742.translation: 图片里出现了提示词中没有的商标。

5742.text: Ask the client whether the trademark should appear in this scene.
5742.translation: 问问客户，这个场景中是否应出现该商标。

13958.text: Keep the image's provenance record with the final export.
13958.translation: 把图像的来源记录与最终导出文件一起保存。

13958.text: The provenance record includes the source file and editing history.
13958.translation: 来源记录包含源文件和编辑历史。

4478.text: Add a short disclosure about the synthetic voice.
4478.translation: 加一段简短说明，披露使用了合成声音。

4478.text: Place the disclosure where viewers can actually read it.
4478.translation: 把披露说明放在观众能看清的位置。

4993.text: We should be transparent about which scenes were AI-generated.
4993.translation: 我们应该明确说明哪些场景由AI生成。

4993.text: The report is transparent about the tests we have not completed.
4993.translation: 报告如实说明了哪些测试尚未完成。

7206.text: The client asked for more transparency about the image sources.
7206.translation: 客户要求更清楚地公开图片来源。

7206.text: This log improves transparency by recording changes to the draft.
7206.translation: 这份日志通过记录草稿修改，提高了过程的透明度。

2962.text: We discussed the ethical issues before making a synthetic presenter.
2962.translation: 制作合成主持人前，我们讨论了相关伦理问题。

2962.text: Is it ethical to imitate this person's voice without asking them?
2962.translation: 没有询问本人就模仿其声音，符合伦理吗？

2777.text: The team has a meeting about the ethics of voice cloning.
2777.translation: 团队会开会讨论声音克隆的伦理问题。

2777.text: Include ethics in the training for new content reviewers.
2777.translation: 在新内容审核员的培训中加入伦理相关内容。

1027.text: Content safety is part of the review before publication.
1027.translation: 发布前的审核包含内容安全检查。

1027.text: The safety check flagged a violent image in the draft.
1027.translation: 安全检查标记了草稿中的一张暴力图像。

9225.text: The moderation team reviews images reported by users.
9225.translation: 内容审核团队会检查用户举报的图片。

9225.text: Show a clear message when moderation blocks a generation request.
9225.translation: 内容审核拦截生成请求时，要显示明确的信息。

399.text: Read the platform's policy on synthetic media before uploading.
399.translation: 上传前，先阅读平台的合成媒体政策。

399.text: Our policy asks reviewers to check the source of every music track.
399.translation: 我们的规定要求审核员检查每首音乐的来源。

3873.text: The compliance review covers the licenses for the stock footage.
3873.translation: 合规审核会检查素材视频的使用许可。

3873.text: Send the release draft to the compliance team for review.
3873.translation: 把发布稿送给合规团队审核。

2686.text: Check whether the license has a restriction on editing the image.
2686.translation: 检查许可是否限制修改图片。

2686.text: The restriction prevents this account from exporting long videos.
2686.translation: 这项限制让这个账户无法导出长视频。

2159.text: Do not include sensitive client information in the prompt.
2159.translation: 不要在提示词中加入敏感的客户信息。

2159.text: The reviewer marked this scene as sensitive content.
2159.translation: 审核员把这个场景标记为敏感内容。

5937.translation: 尚未发布的剧本需要保密。

5937.text: Use a tool approved for confidential material when reviewing this footage.
5937.translation: 审看这段视频时，使用获准处理保密资料的工具。

558.text: Remove personal details from the sample interview.
558.translation: 从示例采访中移除个人信息。

558.text: Does the upload contain anyone's personal contact information?
558.translation: 上传内容里是否包含任何人的个人联系方式？

6895.text: We need to check the authenticity of this interview recording.
6895.translation: 我们需要核查这份采访录音的真实性。

6895.text: The label should not imply authenticity when the image is synthetic.
6895.translation: 图像是合成的，标注就不应暗示它是真实影像。

17911.text: The report describes a possible impersonation of a real presenter.
17911.translation: 报告描述了一起可能冒充真实主持人的情况。

17911.text: Check the platform's impersonation rules before publishing this avatar.
17911.translation: 发布这个虚拟形象前，先检查平台有关冒充他人的规则。

3041.text: The account was reported for suspected fraud.
3041.translation: 这个账户因涉嫌欺诈被举报了。

3041.text: Our review looks for fraud involving fake endorsements.
3041.translation: 我们的审核会排查利用虚假代言进行欺诈的情况。

5561.text: The title is misleading because the scene never happens in the video.
5561.translation: 标题有误导性，因为视频里根本没有出现那个场景。

5561.text: Do not present a synthetic interview as real; that would be misleading.
5561.translation: 不要把合成采访当作真实采访呈现，那会误导观众。

12405.text: The caption repeats misinformation about the event.
12405.translation: 配文重复了有关该事件的错误信息。

12405.text: Check the original report before sharing possible misinformation.
12405.translation: 分享可能有误的信息前，先核对原始报道。

9331.text: Source verification is still pending for this quote.
9331.translation: 这句话的来源仍有待核验。

9331.text: Keep a record of the verification steps for the reviewer.
9331.translation: 记录核验步骤，供审核员查看。

4779.text: Please verify the speaker's name against the original recording.
4779.translation: 请对照原始录音核实说话者的姓名。

4779.text: We should verify this date before adding it to the caption.
4779.translation: 把这个日期写进配文前，我们应该先核实。

278.text: Treat the generated claim as something to check, not as a confirmed fact.
278.translation: 把模型生成的说法当作待核查的内容，而不是已确认的事实。

278.text: This fact comes from the interview, so keep the recording link.
278.translation: 这个事实来自采访，因此要保留录音链接。

7067.text: The citation points to a page that does not support the claim.
7067.translation: 这条引用指向的页面并不能支持该说法。

7067.text: Add a citation next to the statistic in the script.
7067.translation: 在剧本中的统计数字旁加上引用标注。

572.text: What is the source of this background music?
572.translation: 这段背景音乐的来源是什么？

572.text: Keep the source link when you save the reference image.
572.translation: 保存参考图时，保留来源链接。

579.text: We do not have enough evidence to include that claim in the video.
579.translation: 我们的证据不足，不能把那项说法写进视频。

579.text: Save the evidence used to check the quotation.
579.translation: 保存用于核查引文的证据。

3445.text: An invented quote would damage the channel's credibility.
3445.translation: 编造引文会损害频道的可信度。

3445.text: The editor questioned the credibility of this anonymous source.
3445.translation: 编辑对这个匿名来源的可信度提出了质疑。

5080.text: We need a credible source for the numbers in this chart.
5080.translation: 这张图表里的数字需要有可信的来源。

5080.text: The interview is useful, but we should check whether the claim is credible.
5080.translation: 采访有参考价值，但我们应该核查那项说法是否可信。

1236.text: The editor wants a shorter opening shot.
1236.translation: 剪辑师想把开场镜头缩短一些。

1236.text: Ask the editor to check the captions against the recording.
1236.translation: 请编辑对照录音检查字幕。

1614.text: The producer is coordinating the shoot and the review schedule.
1614.translation: 制片人在协调拍摄和审看日程。

1614.text: Tell the producer if another revision will affect the budget.
1614.translation: 如果再修改一轮会影响预算，就告诉制片人。

873.text: Production starts after the script and character designs are approved.
873.translation: 剧本和角色设计确认后，就开始制作。

873.text: Keep the reference images available throughout production.
873.translation: 整个制作过程中都要能随时查看参考图。

501.text: The director asked for a longer pause before the reply.
501.translation: 导演要求在回答前多停顿一会儿。

501.text: Show the director both versions of the camera movement.
501.translation: 把两个版本的镜头运动都给导演看。

17917.text: The cinematographer wants softer light on the actor's face.
17917.translation: 摄影指导想让演员脸上的光更柔和。

17917.text: Discuss the reference shots with the cinematographer before filming.
17917.translation: 拍摄前，和摄影指导讨论参考镜头。

2659.text: The photographer supplied a higher-resolution product image.
2659.translation: 摄影师提供了一张分辨率更高的产品图。

2659.text: Ask the photographer which photo best matches the lighting in this scene.
2659.translation: 问问摄影师，哪张照片最符合这个场景的光线。

3400.text: The brief calls for product photography with a plain background.
3400.translation: 需求说明要求用纯色背景拍摄产品照片。

3400.text: Her photography portfolio helped us choose a visual direction.
3400.translation: 她的摄影作品集帮助我们确定了视觉方向。

16366.text: The animator noticed that the feet slide across the floor.
16366.translation: 动画师发现角色的脚在地板上滑动。

16366.text: Give the animator a clear reference for the character's walk.
16366.translation: 给动画师一份清楚展示角色走路动作的参考。

10214.text: The illustrator needs the character's final costume design.
10214.translation: 插画师需要角色的最终服装设计。

10214.text: Let the illustrator know which details must stay consistent.
10214.translation: 告诉插画师，哪些细节必须保持一致。

690.text: The artist drew three rough versions of the city skyline.
690.translation: 美术师画了三版城市天际线草图。

690.text: We should ask the artist before altering the commissioned painting.
690.translation: 修改委托创作的画作前，我们应该先询问艺术家。

888.text: The writer changed the ending to make the character's choice clearer.
888.translation: 作者修改了结尾，让角色的选择更清楚。

888.text: Send the interview notes to the writer before drafting the narration.
888.translation: 起草旁白前，把采访记录发给作者。

11392.text: The screenwriter added a quiet scene between the two arguments.
11392.translation: 编剧在两场争执之间加了一个安静的场景。

11392.text: Ask the screenwriter whether this line fits the character's background.
11392.translation: 问问编剧，这句台词是否符合角色的背景。

4262.text: The composer wrote a shorter theme for the opening titles.
4262.translation: 作曲家为片头写了一段更短的主题音乐。

4262.text: Give the composer the final scene timing before requesting new music.
4262.translation: 请作曲家写新音乐前，先把最终场景时长给他。

2520.text: The musician recorded another take with a slower tempo.
2520.translation: 音乐人用更慢的速度又录了一遍。

2520.text: Ask the musician which instrument should lead in this section.
2520.translation: 问问音乐人，这一段应该由哪种乐器主奏。

3378.text: The performer needs space to finish the gesture before the cut.
3378.translation: 剪切前，需要给表演者留出时间完成动作。

3378.text: Show the performer the reference movement before recording.
3378.translation: 录制前，先把参考动作给表演者看。

1328.text: The actor wants to hear the previous line before recording the reply.
1328.translation: 录制回应的台词前，演员想先听一下上一句。

1328.text: We need the actor's approval before using a synthetic version of their voice.
1328.translation: 使用演员声音的合成版本前，我们需要获得演员的同意。

2212.text: Our brand needs a clearer message.
2212.translation: 我们的品牌需要更清楚的表达。

2212.text: Does this color fit the brand?
2212.translation: 这个颜色符合品牌风格吗？

608.translation: 这次营销活动下周一开始。

974.text: Who is the audience for this video?

974.translation: 我们的受众更喜欢短教程。

996.text: The customer asked for a refund.
Let's call the customer back today.
996.translation: 我们今天给客户回个电话吧。

955.text: What does the consumer actually need?

955.translation: 这份问卷衡量消费者信任。

412.text: We need to understand the local market.
Is there a market for this product?

377.text: Let's do some research before the launch.
377.translation: 上线前我们先做点调研吧。

377.text: What did the research tell us?

1115.text: Could you complete this short survey?
1115.translation: 能填一下这份简短的问卷吗？

2508.text: Which segment should we focus on?
2508.translation: 我们应该重点关注哪个细分群体？

2508.text: This segment cares more about convenience.
2508.translation: 这个细分群体更看重便利。

783.text: We need a strategy for customer retention.
783.translation: 我们需要一套客户留存策略。

783.text: Does this fit our marketing strategy?
783.translation: 这符合我们的营销策略吗？

5054.text: I saw your advertisement on the train.
5054.translation: 我在火车上看到了你们的广告。

5054.text: The advertisement should show the price clearly.
5054.translation: 广告应该清楚地显示价格。

2273.text: Who handles advertising for this product?
2273.translation: 谁负责这个产品的广告投放？

3238.translation: 这次促销什么时候结束？

3238.text: The promotion brought in new customers.
3238.translation: 这次促销带来了新客户。

3840.text: Can we offer a smaller discount?
3840.translation: 我们能把折扣力度调小一点吗？

3840.text: The discount applies to new subscribers.
3840.translation: 这个折扣适用于新订阅用户。

3982.text: How are we defining a conversion?
3982.translation: 我们把什么行为算作一次转化？

3982.text: The new page improved our conversion rate.
3982.translation: 新页面提高了我们的转化率。

5535.text: Customer retention is our priority this month.
5535.translation: 本月我们重点关注客户留存。

5535.text: How do we measure retention here?

3263.text: The post received very little engagement.
3263.translation: 这条帖子获得的互动很少。

3263.text: Which content gets the most engagement?
3263.translation: 哪类内容获得的互动最多？

2172.text: Which channel brought in these customers?
2172.translation: 这些客户从哪个渠道来的？

2172.text: Let's test one channel at a time.
2172.translation: 我们一次测试一个渠道吧。

2046.text: We need a distribution plan for this guide.
2046.translation: 我们需要给这份指南制定分发计划。

2046.text: Who handles distribution to the stores?

1502.text: Most of our traffic comes from search.
1502.translation: 我们的大部分流量来自搜索。

1502.text: Did the campaign bring in useful traffic?
1502.translation: 这次活动带来了有价值的流量吗？

2187.text: An impression doesn't always mean someone noticed the ad.
2187.translation: 一次展示不一定表示有人注意到了广告。

2187.text: The report lists the cost per impression.
2187.translation: 报告列出了每次展示的成本。

3246.text: The button is clear enough to click.
3246.translation: 这个按钮够清楚，用户能知道可以点击。

3246.text: What happens after the first click?
3246.translation: 第一次点击后会发生什么？

9079.text: Where are people leaving the funnel?
9079.translation: 用户在哪个转化漏斗环节流失？
我们把购买漏斗简化一下吧。

1519.text: This content answers a real customer question.
1519.translation: 这些内容回答了客户的一个实际问题。

1519.text: Can we reuse the content in a newsletter?
1519.translation: 能把这些内容放进通讯邮件里再用一次吗？

2499.text: We're discussing a partnership with a local store.
2499.translation: 我们在和一家本地门店谈合作。

2499.text: What would each side bring to the partnership?
2499.translation: 双方各自能为合作带来什么？

7829.translation: 这个活动还需要更多赞助。

7829.text: What's included in the sponsorship package?

2435.text: What's the main insight from these interviews?
2435.translation: 这些访谈最主要的发现是什么？

2435.text: That insight could change our message.
2435.translation: 这个发现可能会改变我们的表达。

3324.text: Let's collect feedback before changing the design.
3324.translation: 修改设计前，我们先收集反馈吧。

2079.text: This response could hurt our reputation.
2079.translation: 这个回应可能会损害我们的声誉。

2079.text: We need to protect the brand's reputation.
2079.translation: 我们需要维护品牌声誉。

3470.text: The program is meant to build customer loyalty.
3470.translation: 这个计划旨在提高客户忠诚度。
打折真的能提高忠诚度吗？

2799.text: What is our main competitor doing differently?
2799.translation: 我们的主要竞争对手有什么不同做法？

2799.text: Don't copy every move a competitor makes.
2799.translation: 别把竞争对手的每个动作都照搬过来。

736.text: We need growth that we can sustain.
736.translation: 我们需要能持续的增长。
是什么在推动本季度的增长？

1120.text: How did the launch affect sales?
1120.translation: 这次上线对销售有什么影响？

1120.text: Let's compare sales with last month.
1120.translation: 我们和上个月的销售额比一下吧。

343.text: This lead asked for a product demo.
343.translation: 这个潜在客户要求看产品演示。

343.text: Who will follow up on the lead?
343.translation: 谁来跟进这条销售线索？

1528.text: Are we ready for the product launch?
1528.translation: 我们准备好发布产品了吗？

1528.text: Let's delay the launch until the page is ready.
1528.translation: 等页面准备好再发布吧。

1146.text: Is this target realistic for one month?
1146.translation: 这个目标在一个月内实现现实吗？

753.text: The message is getting lost in the design.
753.translation: 设计把我们要表达的信息淹没了。

753.text: Can we make the message easier to understand?
753.translation: 能把表达改得更容易懂吗？

709.text: Which media will cover the event?
709.translation: 哪些媒体会报道这个活动？

709.text: We need a clear response for the media.
709.translation: 我们需要给媒体一个清楚的回应。

355.translation: 这条公告现在已经公开了。

355.text: How did the public respond to the change?
355.translation: 公众对这个变化有什么反应？

12438.text: Is this idea marketable at that price?
12438.translation: 这个想法按那个价格卖，市场会接受吗？

12438.text: We need a marketable benefit, not just a feature.
12438.translation: 我们需要一个能打动市场的好处，不能只讲功能。

6461.text: The advertiser approved the final design.
6461.translation: 广告主批准了最终设计。

6461.text: What does the advertiser want to measure?

3868.text: The event attracted a lot of publicity.
3868.translation: 这个活动获得了很多媒体关注。

3868.text: Not all publicity helps the brand.
3868.translation: 并非所有媒体关注都对品牌有益。

8165.text: A good marketer listens to customers.
8165.translation: 好的营销人员会听客户的意见。

8165.text: Ask the marketer how the leads are qualified.
8165.translation: 问问营销人员怎么筛选合格线索。

1975.text: Marketing needs to work closely with sales.
1975.translation: 营销团队需要和销售团队紧密配合。

1975.text: What's the goal of this marketing plan?
1975.translation: 这份营销计划的目标是什么？

1926.text: This item is on sale until Sunday.
The first sale came through the newsletter.
1926.translation: 第一笔销售来自通讯邮件。

3905.text: This product is becoming a commodity.
3905.translation: 这个产品正在变得同质化。

3905.text: Price matters more when buyers see a commodity.
3905.translation: 当买家认为商品没什么差别时，价格更重要。

7436.text: The billing page is confusing customers.
7436.translation: 计费页面让客户看不明白。

7436.text: Can we explain the billing cycle clearly?
7436.translation: 能把计费周期解释清楚吗？

550.text: What problem does the product solve?
550.translation: 这个产品解决什么问题？

550.text: Let's show the product in use.
550.translation: 我们展示一下产品实际使用的样子吧。

474.text: The price should be visible before checkout.
474.translation: 结账之前就应该显示价格。
客户会愿意付那个价格吗？

956.text: We have enough budget for one test.
956.translation: 我们的预算够做一次测试。

956.text: How much of the budget is left?

1477.translation: 这次活动让收入增加了吗？

1477.text: Revenue is up, but costs are up too.
1477.translation: 收入增加了，但成本也增加了。

1497.text: We need to look at profit as well as revenue.
1497.translation: 除了收入，我们也得看利润。

1497.text: The discount reduced our profit per order.
1497.translation: 这个折扣降低了每笔订单的利润。

429.text: We want to reach more local customers.
429.translation: 我们想接触更多本地客户。

429.text: How many people did the campaign reach?
429.translation: 这次活动触达了多少人？

2583.text: Let's lower the frequency of these ads.
2583.translation: 我们把这些广告的出现频率降一点吧。

2583.text: High frequency can annoy the audience.
2583.translation: 过高的频率会让受众反感。

1923.text: The sponsorship gives us useful exposure.
1923.translation: 这次赞助能给我们带来有价值的曝光。

1923.text: Exposure alone doesn't prove the campaign worked.
1923.translation: 仅有曝光不能证明活动有效。

2389.text: Our first goal is to build brand awareness.
2389.translation: 我们的首要目标是提高品牌认知。

2389.text: How will we measure awareness after the event?
2389.translation: 活动后我们怎么衡量认知度？

3298.translation: 我们的获客成本在上升。

3298.text: Let's compare acquisition with retention spending.
3298.translation: 我们比较一下获客和留存方面的支出吧。

2143.text: This guide supports customers in the consideration stage.
2143.translation: 这份指南帮助处于购买考虑阶段的客户。

2143.text: Price isn't the only consideration for this audience.
2143.translation: 价格不是这类受众唯一考虑的因素。

1866.text: Can customers complete a purchase on their phones?
1866.translation: 客户能用手机完成购买吗？

1866.text: What stopped you from making the purchase?
1866.translation: 是什么让你没有买下去？

5507.text: This customer came through a referral.
5507.translation: 这位客户是别人推荐来的。

5507.text: How does the referral program work?

2258.text: A happy customer can become a brand advocate.
2258.translation: 满意的客户可以成为品牌拥护者。

2258.text: We advocate clear pricing in every campaign.
2258.translation: 我们主张每次活动都把价格说清楚。

344.text: Let's adapt the video for social media.
344.translation: 我们把这个视频改成适合社交平台的版本吧。
谁管理我们的社交账号？

2409.text: Which platform does our audience use most?
2409.translation: 我们的受众最常用哪个平台？

2409.text: The platform changed its advertising rules.
2409.translation: 这个平台改了广告规则。

4225.text: Our website needs a clearer signup page.
4225.translation: 我们的网站需要更清楚的注册页面。

4225.text: Does the website work well on mobile?

667.text: This page takes too long to load.
Let's put the main benefit at the top of the page.
667.translation: 我们把主要好处放在页面顶部吧。

5208.text: Would you like to receive our newsletter?
5208.translation: 你想接收我们的通讯邮件吗？

5208.text: The newsletter should include an unsubscribe link.
5208.translation: 通讯邮件应该包含退订链接。

1330.text: What do customers search for before buying?
1330.translation: 客户购买前会搜索什么？

1330.text: Let's check the search results for that phrase.
1330.translation: 我们看看那个短语的搜索结果吧。

8540.text: Which metric tells us whether this worked?
8540.translation: 哪个指标能告诉我们这次是否有效？

8540.text: Don't change the metric halfway through the test.
8540.translation: 测试中途别换衡量指标。

2773.text: Our measurement plan needs a clear time window.
2773.translation: 我们的衡量计划需要明确的时间范围。

2773.text: Use the same measurement method for both groups.
2773.translation: 两组都用同一种衡量方法。

3244.text: What does bounce rate mean in this report?
3244.translation: 这份报告中的跳出率是什么意思？

3244.text: The bounce rate depends on the tool's definition.
3244.translation: 跳出率取决于工具采用的定义。

829.text: How many people visit the page each day?
829.translation: 每天有多少人访问这个页面？

829.text: Let's visit the store before planning the promotion.
829.translation: 策划促销前，我们先去门店看看吧。

1492.text: Can a new visitor understand the offer?
1492.translation: 新访客能看懂这个优惠吗？

1492.text: The visitor left before reaching the signup form.
1492.translation: 这位访客还没看到注册表单就离开了。

6090.text: Each subscriber should know what they'll receive.
6090.translation: 每位订阅用户都应该知道自己会收到什么。

6090.text: How much does each subscriber cost us to acquire?
6090.translation: 我们获取每位订阅用户要花多少钱？

7003.text: Can customers cancel the subscription easily?
7003.translation: 客户能方便地取消订阅吗？

823.text: The free trial lasts for two weeks.
What happens when the trial ends?

386.text: The offer needs a clear expiry date.
386.translation: 这个优惠需要明确的截止日期。

386.text: Would this offer appeal to new customers?
386.translation: 这个优惠能吸引新客户吗？

4615.text: Our value proposition is easy to explain.
4615.translation: 我们的价值主张容易解释清楚。

4615.text: Does the proposition match what customers need?
4615.translation: 这个主张符合客户的需要吗？

492.text: Show the value before asking people to pay.
492.translation: 先展示价值，再请用户付费。

492.text: What value does this feature add?
492.translation: 这个功能增加了什么价值？

1151.text: Demand is higher during the holiday season.
Is the campaign creating demand or just shifting it?
1151.translation: 这次活动在创造需求，还是只把需求转移了？

932.text: Lead generation needs a better follow-up process.
932.translation: 获取销售线索需要更好的后续跟进流程。

932.text: Which channel supports demand generation best?
932.translation: 哪个渠道最能帮助培育需求？

6665.text: Our outreach email should be short and personal.
6665.translation: 我们的主动联系邮件应该简短、有针对性。

6665.text: Who's handling outreach to potential partners?
6665.translation: 谁负责主动联系潜在合作方？

657.text: The agency sent us three design options.
657.translation: 代理机构发来了三个设计方案。

657.text: What does the agency need from us?
657.translation: 代理机构需要我们提供什么？

3737.text: This placement reaches the audience we want.
3737.translation: 这个投放位置能接触到我们想找的受众。

3737.text: Check the placement before approving the ad.
3737.translation: 批准广告前先检查投放位置。

2828.text: The headline should state the main benefit.
2828.translation: 标题应该说清楚主要好处。
我们测试一个更短的标题吧。

5151.text: The slogan is catchy but unclear.
5151.translation: 这个标语容易记住，但意思不清楚。

5151.text: Can the slogan work in another language?
5151.translation: 这个标语换成另一种语言也适用吗？

1780.text: The creative needs a stronger opening.
1780.translation: 这个广告素材需要更有力的开头。

1780.text: Let's compare the new creative with the old one.
1780.translation: 我们把新旧广告素材比较一下吧。

776.text: The design makes the price hard to find.
776.translation: 这个设计让价格很难找。

776.text: Can we simplify the design without losing the message?
776.translation: 能在保留信息的同时简化设计吗？

6632.text: Our attribution model gives too much credit to the last click.
6632.translation: 我们的归因模型把过多功劳给了最后一次点击。
归因不一定证明因果关系。

18876.text: The segmentation should reflect real customer differences.
18876.translation: 细分应该反映客户的实际差异。
哪些数据支持这样的细分？

6372.text: This persona is based on customer interviews.
6372.translation: 这个用户画像是基于客户访谈做的。

6372.text: Does the persona reflect our actual buyers?
6372.translation: 这个画像反映了我们的实际买家吗？

2077.text: Let's map the customer journey from search to purchase.
2077.translation: 我们把客户从搜索到购买的过程画出来吧。

2077.text: Where does the journey become confusing?
2077.translation: 这个流程在哪一步开始让人困惑？

2001.text: The prospect asked about the yearly plan.
2001.translation: 这个潜在客户问了年费套餐。

2001.text: Who will contact the prospect next?
2001.translation: 接下来谁联系这个潜在客户？

5784.text: What are our lead qualification criteria?
5784.translation: 我们的销售线索筛选标准是什么？

5784.text: Qualification should happen before a sales call.
5784.translation: 销售电话之前应该先筛选线索。

534.text: What's the cost of acquiring one customer?
534.translation: 获得一个客户要花多少钱？

534.text: The cost is higher than we expected.

2840.text: The promotion leaves us with a thin margin.
2840.translation: 这次促销让我们的利润率很低。

2840.text: What's the margin on this product?
2840.translation: 这个产品的利润率是多少？

361.text: How much did we spend on the campaign?
361.translation: 这次活动我们花了多少钱？

361.text: Let's move some spend to the better channel.
361.translation: 我们把部分支出转到效果更好的渠道吧。

3462.text: Our bid is too high for this audience.
3462.translation: 针对这类受众，我们的出价过高了。

3462.text: Should we raise the bid or improve the ad?
3462.translation: 我们应该提高出价，还是改进广告？

14180.text: The page needs optimization for mobile users.
14180.translation: 这个页面需要针对手机用户优化。

14180.text: Optimization should follow a clear hypothesis.
14180.translation: 优化应该基于一个明确的假设。

1732.text: What do we want to learn from this experiment?
1732.translation: 我们想从这次实验中学到什么？

1732.text: Let's run the experiment for a full week.
1732.translation: 我们把这个实验做满一周吧。

1182.text: The new logo should keep our brand identity.
1182.translation: 新标志应该保留我们的品牌识别。

1182.text: Does this page match our visual identity?
1182.translation: 这个页面符合我们的视觉识别吗？

21192.text: Our positioning is clear, but the homepage doesn't reflect it yet.
21192.translation: 我们的品牌定位很清楚，但首页还没有体现出来。

21192.text: Let's agree on the positioning before writing the campaign brief.
21192.translation: 写活动需求说明前，我们先统一品牌定位吧。

21193.text: The branding feels too formal for this audience.
21193.translation: 对这群受众来说，这套品牌表达显得太正式了。

21193.text: Who's handling the branding for the new product line?
21193.translation: 新产品线的品牌塑造由谁负责？

21194.text: The rebranding includes a new name and updated packaging.
21194.translation: 这次品牌重塑包括更换名称和更新包装。

21194.text: We need to explain the rebranding to existing customers.
21194.translation: 我们需要向现有客户解释这次品牌重塑。

6800.text: Use last year's campaign as a benchmark for this launch.
6800.translation: 把去年的活动作为这次发布的对标基准。

6800.text: Which benchmark are we using to compare the results?
6800.translation: 我们用哪个基准比较结果？

21195.text: The benchmarking report compares three competing brands.
21195.translation: 这份对标分析报告比较了三个竞争品牌。

21195.text: Include customer support in the benchmarking, not just price.
21195.translation: 对标分析要纳入客户服务，不能只比较价格。

8841.text: What is our clearest point of differentiation?
8841.translation: 我们最明确的差异化之处是什么？

8841.text: The differentiation needs to be visible in the product demo.
8841.translation: 产品演示中需要看得出这种差异化。

4027.text: The bottle has a distinctive shape, even without the label.
4027.translation: 即使没有标签，这个瓶子的形状也很有辨识度。

4027.text: We need a more distinctive opening for the ad.
4027.translation: 这条广告需要一个更有辨识度的开头。

2108.text: We're testing brand recognition with and without the logo.
2108.translation: 我们正在测试有标志和没有标志时的品牌识别情况。

2108.text: The survey asked about recognition of the new packaging.
2108.translation: 调查询问了消费者是否认得新包装。

1023.text: The follow-up survey measures brand recall after the campaign.
1023.translation: 后续调查会衡量活动结束后的品牌回忆度。

1023.text: Ask about recall before showing participants the logo.
1023.translation: 先询问参与者能否回忆起品牌，再展示标志。

21196.text: The team is testing the memorability of three possible names.
21196.translation: 团队正在测试三个候选名称是否容易被记住。

21196.text: How will we measure the memorability of this slogan?
21196.translation: 我们如何衡量这句广告语是否容易被记住？

15894.text: We want to improve brand salience when people shop for gifts.
15894.translation: 我们希望人们选购礼物时，更容易想到这个品牌。

15894.text: The research looks at salience in several buying situations.
15894.translation: 这项研究考察了品牌在几种购买情境下的显著性。

1628.text: We don't want an association with cheap, disposable products.
1628.translation: 我们不希望品牌让人联想到廉价的一次性产品。

1628.text: The new colors created an association with outdoor travel.
1628.translation: 新配色让人联想到户外旅行。

1633.text: Customer perception changed after the packaging update.
1633.translation: 包装更新后，消费者的感知发生了变化。

1633.text: Let's check the perception of the brand before changing its message.
1633.translation: 改变品牌信息前，我们先看看消费者如何看待它吧。

21197.text: The perceived value is lower than we expected.
21197.translation: 消费者感知到的价值比我们预期的低。

21197.text: We asked whether the brand was perceived as friendly or formal.
21197.translation: 我们询问了消费者觉得这个品牌是亲切还是正式。

502.text: The report describes our position in the local market.
502.translation: 报告描述了我们在当地市场的位置。

502.text: A lower price might change the brand's position.
502.translation: 降低价格可能会改变品牌的市场位置。

1279.text: The delivery team needs to be able to keep our brand promise.
1279.translation: 配送团队需要能兑现我们的品牌承诺。

1279.text: Don't make a promise in the ad that the product can't keep.
1279.translation: 别在广告里做出产品无法兑现的承诺。

1799.text: The brand's personality should come through in the captions.
1799.translation: 品牌个性应当体现在配文里。

1799.text: The playful animation doesn't fit our brand personality.
1799.translation: 这个俏皮的动画不符合我们的品牌个性。

735.text: The brand's character feels warm and practical.
735.translation: 这个品牌的性格给人温暖、务实的感觉。

735.text: We're introducing a new character in the holiday campaign.
735.translation: 我们将在节日活动中推出一个新的形象角色。

13102.text: The team chose the explorer archetype for the brand workshop.
13102.translation: 团队在品牌工作坊中选择了探索者原型。

13102.text: Use the archetype as a discussion tool, not a rule for every ad.
13102.translation: 把品牌原型当作讨论工具，别让每条广告都受它限制。

2728.text: The packaging tells the story of the brand's heritage.
2728.translation: 包装讲述了这个品牌的传承故事。

2728.text: We want to show our heritage without making the design feel old.
2728.translation: 我们想展示品牌传承，同时别让设计显得过时。

993.text: Our mission needs to be understandable to a first-time visitor.
993.translation: 我们的品牌使命需要让首次访问的人也能理解。

993.text: Can you connect this campaign to the company's mission?
993.translation: 你能把这次活动与公司的使命联系起来吗？

1095.text: The vision statement is too vague to guide this project.
1095.translation: 这份愿景陈述太笼统，无法指导这个项目。

1095.text: Let's turn the vision into a clear message for the launch.
1095.translation: 我们把愿景转化为发布时的一条清楚信息吧。

920.text: What purpose does the brand serve beyond selling the product?
920.translation: 除了销售产品，这个品牌还想实现什么目的？

920.text: The campaign should explain our purpose with a concrete example.
920.translation: 活动应该用一个具体例子说明我们存在的目的。

6895.text: The interview adds authenticity to the brand story.
6895.translation: 这段采访让品牌故事显得更真实。

6895.text: We lost some authenticity when we rewrote the customer's own words.
6895.translation: 改写客户原话后，内容少了一些真实感。

3445.text: Show the source of that claim to improve its credibility.
3445.translation: 展示这项说法的来源，提高它的可信度。

3445.text: The testimonial has more credibility when it includes a specific example.
3445.translation: 这条推荐评价包含具体例子时，更有可信度。

1609.text: We need to rebuild trust after the delivery problems.
1609.translation: 配送出了问题后，我们需要重新建立消费者信任。

1609.text: Clear explanations can help customers trust the process.
1609.translation: 清楚的说明有助于让客户信任这个流程。

10964.text: The page should feel trustworthy without making exaggerated claims.
10964.translation: 页面要让人觉得可信，别做夸大的宣传。

10964.text: Would you find this review trustworthy if you were a new customer?
10964.translation: 如果你是新客户，会觉得这条评价可信吗？

7206.text: Customers asked for more transparency about the extra fees.
7206.translation: 客户要求更清楚地说明额外费用。

7206.text: The transparency of the offer matters as much as the headline.
7206.translation: 优惠信息是否透明，与标题同样重要。

4244.text: Check the consistency of the message across the email and landing page.
4244.translation: 检查邮件和落地页的信息是否一致。

4244.text: The campaign needs better consistency in its colors and tone.
4244.translation: 这次活动的配色和语气需要更加一致。

1920.text: Keep the product name consistent across all channels.
1920.translation: 在所有渠道中保持产品名称一致。

1920.text: The prices aren't consistent between the ad and the checkout page.
1920.translation: 广告和结算页的价格不一致。

9668.text: The story needs more coherence from the first ad to the final offer.
9668.translation: 从第一条广告到最终优惠，整个故事需要更加连贯。

9668.text: We reviewed the coherence of the new brand identity.
9668.translation: 我们检查了新品牌形象的整体连贯性。

2507.text: Make a clear distinction between the basic and premium plans.
2507.translation: 明确区分基础套餐和高端套餐。

2507.text: The main distinction is the level of support included.
2507.translation: 主要区别在于包含的服务支持级别。

9977.text: The client wants to highlight the uniqueness of the handmade designs.
9977.translation: 客户想突出这些手工设计的独特性。

9977.text: We need evidence for the claimed uniqueness of this material.
9977.translation: 我们需要证据来支持这种材料独特性的宣传说法。

1514.text: Give each offer a unique code so we can track it.
1514.translation: 给每项优惠一个独立代码，方便跟踪。

1514.text: What makes this product unique to a first-time buyer?
1514.translation: 对首次购买的人来说，这个产品有什么独特之处？

4091.text: The premium version includes an extra year of support.
4091.translation: 高端版本包含额外一年的服务支持。

4091.text: The photos need to justify the product's premium price.
4091.translation: 这些照片需要体现出产品为何定价更高。

5661.text: The partnership could strengthen the brand's prestige.
5661.translation: 这项合作可能会提升品牌声望。

5661.text: We want to convey prestige without sounding distant.
5661.translation: 我们想传达品牌声望，同时别让语气显得疏远。
